youtube.title: What If You Woke Up in the Year 3000?
tags: what if you woke up in the year 3000
youtube.intro:
You close your eyes in a cheap sleep pod in 2026. You open them in the year 3000. Your phone is in a museum, nobody can understand your English, a robot named Vee is your only friend, and your money ran out 974 years ago. How long could you survive with nothing but 2026 knowledge?

An original animated story. The characters and the future are made up. The science behind it is real, and the sources are below.
youtube.pinned_comment:
What would YOU do first in the year 3000? 👇 Find your family, sell your 2026 stories, or hide in the glass room forever?

The science is real: cold and flu viruses change faster than your immune system can keep up, English from the year 1000 is almost unreadable today, and 32 generations back you have over 4 billion ancestor spots, so nearly everyone is family. Sources are in the description.

And one of you is the copy... Part two is coming.
